dogecoin.text:
Other notable memecoins that followed include:
Shiba Inu $SHIB: Dubbed the “Dogecoin Killer." Did it kill it? Shiba Inu leveraged the Ethereum network to introduce staking and DeFi utilities. https://t.co/0glhNdtvvo

The concept of memecoins dates back to 2013 with the launch of Dogecoin $DOGE, created by Billy Markus and Jackson Palmer as a playful alternative to Bitcoin. Initially, Dogecoin gained traction due to its vibrant online community and charitable fundraising efforts.
